annotations.title: Respond with a sealed bid or quote

description: Place or update your response on an open listing (bid on an offer, quote on a request). Sealed by default: nobody sees it until the round closes. Requires API key. Ask the user before responding.

amount.description: Amount in the listing currency (major units). Omit for non-price responses.

message.description: Facts for the poster: what you deliver, when, conditions. No contact details.

name: respond
